summary: A State of the State asks the legislature for things; an inaugural rarely does.
realLife: 13% of State of the State points ended in an ask of lawmakers, against 1% of inaugural points.
sources: docs/story/research/address-moves.md (Elections lane, Nov 24, 2026: 6 inaugurals and 6 State of the State addresses read whole, 175 points coded)
inGame: The state-of-the-state row (kinds.state-of-the-state in data/english/outlines.json) with body-word (the legislature) and realm-name; stance and law facts gate pledge and stand.

turns.what: No ask of the legislature; the speaker asks the public.
turns.pulledBy: a body held by the other party (party-holds-body false)
turns.writesBack: The paper reports an appeal over the legislature's head.

turns.what: A soft ask: the speaker names a bill and waits.
turns.pulledBy: a body held by the speaker's party
turns.writesBack: The bill record can move without a pledge on it.
